text: Take a moment and notice your breathing.
You don't have to change it.
Feel the weight of yourself. Here. Present. Alive.
Some days are beautiful. Some days are hard.
You don't need to sort any of that out right now.
See if one moment comes to mind that you'd like to spend a little more time with.
Maybe a familiar voice. A meal shared with someone. The sound of laughter filling a room.
Notice what it feels like to remember.
If no memory comes, stay with your breath. You're here.
Now begin to notice the room around you again. Feel where your hands are resting.
This moment is part of your life, too.
When you're ready, gently open your eyes.
